purpose: v025 MAF transfer convex smoothing verification (mid-warmup FMEM avoidance, warm 950-RPM idle stability, fan-off recovery, and stationary 1,500/2,000/2,500 RPM off-idle holds)

tune.installation_evidence: Prepared candidate; owner write pending; no ECU readback

changes_since_previous_run: Relative to v024: single table ECM12163 MAF Airflow vs. Voltage smoothed across columns 6-13 (0.500-1.000 V); all other 22 columns and all 30 voltage breakpoints 100% identical. Notes appended; zero DTC or fuel/spark table changes. New upstream O2 sensor retained.

profile.filename: profiles/2004 Focus SVT - V023 Idle Spark Trial.Channels.xml
profile.status: All 18 requested channels required; paired with SCG-1 wideband lambda

conditions.start_ect_f: Cool or cold preferred (<90 F) to check mid-warmup FMEM retention at 128-162 F
conditions.accessories: Fixed OFF during warmup/baseline (A/C, defrost, blower, headlights OFF)
conditions.upstream_o2: New upstream O2 installed prior to v024 test; confirmed active switching
conditions.crank_sensor_and_grounds: Unchanged CKP sensor; zero sync drops in v024 test

planned_actions: Stage A1: Cold/cool start through 60-90s CL entry and mid-warmup (115-165 F, 1,100-1,350 RPM); verify Open Loop FMEM remains No and fast-idle STFT within authority (-5% to -12%)
Stage A2: Settled warm idle (180-195 F, 60-90s untouched in neutral, clutch up); assess RPM SD (target <= 22 RPM), STFT (+-5%), and lambda (~1.00)
Stage A3: Warm radiator fan cycle (~196 F ON, ~188 F OFF) followed by at least 60 seconds of untouched idle post-fan-off recovery
Stage B1: Parked 1,500 RPM hold (15-20s, MAF_V ~ 0.82-0.86 V); verify Stoich CL active, STFT +-8%, and clean return without lean spike
Stage B2: Parked 2,000 RPM hold (15-20s, MAF_V ~ 0.94-0.99 V); verify Power Demand Enrich OL active, steady SCG lambda ~0.83-0.88, no lean misfire
Stage B3: Parked 2,500 RPM hold (15-20s, MAF_V ~ 1.05-1.15 V); verify Power Demand Enrich OL active, steady SCG lambda ~0.80-1.02, clean return to 950 RPM
stop_conditions: Stall or near-stall (<650 RPM), or worsening repeated stumbles relative to v024 (min 816.5 RPM)
Steady warm SCG Lambda > 1.08 for >3 seconds at idle/CL, or steady SCG Lambda > 1.05 for >3 seconds during 2,000-2,500 RPM OL holds
Warm closed-loop STFT pinned positive (> +18%) or negative (< -20%)
Fuel rail pressure sensor anomaly (FRP collapse or new P0190/P0192/P0193 MIL) or CKP sync fault (P0320)
uncovered_until_tested: Boost operation (>= 1.100 V untouched, not boost-validated)
